title: Hand out a team's members without handing over the list

blocks.text: A getter that returns a mutable collection hands the caller the object's own insides. The page's answer is to return an **unmodifiable view**, as the course's `Person.getHobbies()` does with `Collections.unmodifiableList`. The same care applies on the way in: a list passed to the constructor still belongs to the caller.

items: `Team(String name, List<String> members)` starts the team with those members;
`List<String> getMembers()` returns the members in order, as a list the caller **cannot change**;

blocks.text: After construction, nothing the caller does to the list it passed in, or to a list it got from `getMembers()`, may change the team.

cases.says: The team lists its starting members, then each added member, in order.
Adding to or clearing the list the getter returns throws UnsupportedOperationException and leaves the team unchanged.
Changing the list passed to the constructor afterwards does not change the team.

concepts: A getter for a collection returns an unmodifiable view, and a collection passed in is copied.
